features.note: Two clearly visible physical decks inventory. Long rear deck and smaller middle deck were traced; four unrelated tiny historic OSM references and synthetic rectangles are removed from this hole inventory. Tree shadows prevent a claim of complete deck census. Legacy references0–2 provisionally refer to the visible rear deck, reference4 to the visible middle deck. References3 and5 remain unresolved virtual starts; no daily marker positions are inferred. Runtime footprint inference is suppressed as a separate source policy.

Visible small middle deck west of the legacy reference4. The reference is moved onto this physical turf footprint provisionally, not interpreted as a daily marker.

References0–1 provisionally use the visible rear deck and2–3 the visible middle deck; reference5 remains an unresolved virtual fairway start. Shadow prevents a complete-source-accuracy claim. Visible elongated physical deck immediately north of the crossing path, with its rounded northern end and narrow southern end.
Visible forward physical deck east of the pond. Supplies the provisional platform reference for legacy reference4, which previously lay in water.

Historical OSM w1527513658 boundary retained exactly from the baseline. Tree shadow prevents independent tracing of its complete perimeter in the2024 orthophoto; this outline is not claimed to be newly traced or source-accurate. No virtual reference is newly assigned to this uncertain deck.
